name: Azeroth Companion
title: Talent Forge Planner — Sovereign Build Architect
features: Transformed Talent Forge into a complete manual Build Architect workspace with Raid, Mythic+, PvP, Solo, Open World and general planning purposes, role/style annotations and up to 1,800 characters of encounter or rotation notes.

Added separate user-defined Class, Specialization and Hero point targets, plus a source-aware live rank breakdown and review panel that clearly distinguishes structural issues from unverified Blizzard gameplay rules.
Added browser-local unsaved draft recovery for ranks, choices, notes and targets, with explicit Restore/Discard controls so a working copy does not silently overwrite a loaded draft.

Expanded the existing saved library with draft duplication and a human-readable copyable build brief identifying selected talent names and allocated ranks; kept existing comparison, Undo/Redo and JSON export.
Retained the original v1 saved-draft JSON and browser storage key while adding optional planner metadata, preserving old saves and allowing strict backward-compatible import.
Hardened imported build JSON with bounded size, specialization identifiers, numeric node/choice limits, cleanup against the current Blizzard-returned tree, and safe local-only persistence.

Preserved the secure Blizzard Worker, all existing Azeroth studios, v5.0 website experience, source-link analysis, responsive layouts and four-resource delivery without new API endpoints or OAuth permissions.
Added dedicated desktop Chromium and mobile WebKit browser integration tests with explicitly synthetic talent data, plus pure engine validation tests and maintenance documentation.
